name: Brushed aluminum
where_seen: The plate the VIN is struck on, the brand, a dialog's head, and every key: a button is a key of this metal, raised on a steel ledge.
texture: A fine horizontal brush over a light-to-mid grey gradient; characters are struck in, lit below and shadowed above. The same in both colour schemes.

name: Aluminum, pressed
where_seen: A key held down, the mode shown, and a stock strip that is open: flush, 2px down, with an inner shadow.
texture: The metal a step darker, the tape's ridges across it, no brush.

name: The second tape
where_seen: The part type picker's key, a part type in its list, and a candidate's stock strip: a name that is pressed.
texture: Embossing tape in the plate's own metal: the brushed aluminum with the tape's faint ridges over it.

name: Label tape
where_seen: A tag's number band, the names under the cards, and a strip naming what a panel holds: stuck on, static.
texture: Black label-maker vinyl with faint ridges across it and a lit top edge; letters are raised white. The same in both colour schemes.

name: Label tape, pressed
where_seen: A control of label tape held down or chosen.
texture: The tape darker, its ridges stronger, its gradient turned over.

name: Manila
where_seen: Every card of the decode, hung by its eyelet from its group's line; and under the cards a vehicle's names, every candidate and every vehicle a part fits: a parts tag laid long, its eyelet at its leading end.
texture: A parts tag's stock with tooth, clipped corners and a reinforced patch around its eyelet; ink is printed on it. The same in both colour schemes.

name: Pinstripe tape
where_seen: The brackets over the plate, the leader lines to the cards, and the trunk with its stubs to the picker and every candidate: one colour for each group of the VIN.
texture: A 5px line of coloured tape, lit on its upper left edge and casting a small shadow on the ground. Six colours, shown as the light scheme has them; the dark scheme's are lighter.
css: linear-gradient(#c8102e 0 0) 0 10px / 100% 5px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#0b4fa8 0 0) 0 22px / 100% 5px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#5b2d8e 0 0) 0 78px / 100% 5px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#a34c09 0 0) 0 90px / 100% 5px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#0f6b46 0 0) 100% 0 / 5px 100% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#3d4650 0 0) calc(100% - 12px) 0 / 5px 100% no-repeat, #dcecf7

name: Thermal paper
where_seen: A candidate's open stock rows, and a part's: what a stock file says of a part, fed out from under its row and torn at the foot.
texture: Off-white coated paper, shaded where it leaves the tag, printed in one near-black in the monospace face: a reversed bar over each kind of stock, column names over a rule of dashes, a row a line with its location in bold, and the fields no column holds folded under it in fainter print. The same in both colour schemes.
css: linear-gradient(rgb(8 7 15 / .32), rgb(8 7 15 / .07) 6px, transparent 15px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(8 7 15 / .05), transparent 2% 98%, rgb(8 7 15 / .05)), #f6f4ee

name: Ink stamp
where_seen: A candidate's mark for something checked: the decode met the catalog's condition, or the part is filed under another type or replaces a retired number.
texture: A solid 2px box in the tag's ink around upper-case label face, turned a degree and a half, as a rubber stamp lands.
css: linear-gradient(#2b2418 0 0) 24px 24px / 170px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#2b2418 0 0) 24px calc(80px - 2px) / 170px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#2b2418 0 0) 24px 24px / 2px 56px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#2b2418 0 0) calc(194px - 2px) 24px / 2px 56px no-repeat, url(paper.svg) 0 0 / 200px 200px, linear-gradient(#efdcae, #e2c88f)

name: Dashed stamp
where_seen: A candidate's mark for a doubt: the decode has no value for what the catalog asks. Dashed is a doubt everywhere on the page.
texture: The stamp's box, dashed and unturned. Plain words in the tag's ink, with no box, are nothing checked.
css: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #2b2418 0 7px, transparent 7px 12px) 24px 24px / 170px 2px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #2b2418 0 7px, transparent 7px 12px) 24px calc(80px - 2px) / 170px 2px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #2b2418 0 7px, transparent 7px 12px) 24px 24px / 2px 56px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #2b2418 0 7px, transparent 7px 12px) calc(194px - 2px) 24px / 2px 56px no-repeat, url(paper.svg) 0 0 / 200px 200px, linear-gradient(#efdcae, #e2c88f)

name: Blank strip
where_seen: Where the page has no answer the place stays: one sentence in a dashed outline, and in it a key of metal or a link on.
texture: A 3px dashed outline in the faint colour on the bare ground, muted words inside. No material: the mark of an empty place.
css: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #a9bccb 0 7px, transparent 7px 12px) 24px 24px / 170px 3px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #a9bccb 0 7px, transparent 7px 12px) 24px calc(80px - 3px) / 170px 3px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #a9bccb 0 7px, transparent 7px 12px) 24px 24px / 3px 56px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #a9bccb 0 7px, transparent 7px 12px) calc(194px - 3px) 24px / 3px 56px no-repeat, #dcecf7

name: Recess
where_seen: Text to copy, and the filter over the part types: a field sunk into its panel.
texture: The panel's ground a step darker under an inner shadow along its top edge, inside a 1px line.

name: Rivet
where_seen: One at the near end of a header's button and each end of the brand: what holds a piece of metal on.
texture: A dark dome ringed in light metal, drawn at the plate's edge. A dialog's head takes a slotted screw at each end.

name: The ground, light
where_seen: The page itself in the light scheme, behind every material.
texture: A flat pale blue. Not a material: what the materials sit on and cast their shadows on.

name: The ground, dark
where_seen: The page itself in the dark scheme.
texture: A flat dark blue. The metal, the tape and the manila do not change over it; the pinstripes lighten.
